Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Population ages 0-14 (% of total population)', what value is listed for Moldova (MDA) in 2023?

A. 19.9922238488199%
B. 15.0109897220706%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Population ages 0-14 (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.0014.TO.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)

Supplied draft answer: A
